  "description": "Organic Maps is a privacy-focused, offline-capable mobile mapping application for Android and iOS. It provides detailed map visualization, turn-by-turn navigation, search, and track management using OpenStreetMap data. It explicitly excludes cloud connectivity features such as push notifications, user accounts, or telemetry.",

      "notes": "Provides native mobile UI for map visualization and navigation. However, it lacks the specific 'Team Leader' reporting features (diary submission, alert acknowledgement) required by the component. It is a consumer-grade mapping app, not a tactical team coordination tool."

    "Requires mobile OS (Android or iOS)",

    "No internet connection required for core functionality"
  ],
  "maturity": "stable",
  "adaptation_hours_estimate": 120,
  "adaptation_confidence": "low",
  "adaptation_assumptions": [
    "Assumes ability to fork the C++ core and rewrite Android/iOS UI layers completely.",
    "Assumes 'No push notifications' constraint can be overridden by integrating FCM/APNS, which contradicts the project's privacy philosophy.",
    "Assumes custom backend integration for diary/alert submission is built externally as this app has no networking stack for user data."
  ],
  "known_gaps": [
    "No Push Notification support (FCM/APNS) - explicitly excluded by design.",
    "No WebSocket support for real-time alert relay.",
    "No HTTPS POST API for diary entry or position report submission.",
    "No 'Team Leader' specific UI or workflow.",
    "No user authentication or account management."
  ],
  "risks": [
    "License: Apache 2.0 is permissive, but the app's privacy-first design may conflict with defense requirements for data reporting.",
    "Maintenance: Forking a consumer app to add enterprise features may lead to divergence and high maintenance costs.",
    "Security: The app explicitly avoids network connectivity; adding it introduces attack surface not originally designed for."
  ],
  "evidence": [
    {
      "claim": "Organic Maps is an offline maps app with no push notifications or tracking.",

    },
